caption: The drawing features a central rectangular panel divided in two vertical halves, both decorated with similar motifs. Each half contains a garland composed of assorted fruits and flowers, illustrated with detailed linework and shading. The garlands are suspended from the top corners and center, draping downward and held up by ribbons or cords, with bows visible at the attachment points. The background behind the garlands is decorated with draped fabric that radiates outward from the hanging points, creating a pleated appearance. Along the bottom of the panel is a border decorated with a repeating triangular pattern, and each half of the central design contains stylized fruit and floral elements, including pineapples and large, round blooms. The composition employs mainly muted blue and reddish-brown tones for the outlines, shading, and fill, while the wider background remains a plain, off-white color. The artist's name, "Frances Lichten," appears in small print at the bottom right corner.
title: Wall Paper Border
